# Activity

The current action.

`LL.Activity` · Shell

## Use

```jsx
<LL.Activity label="Engaged in Combat" remaining="00:12" progress={0.4} onOpen={goToAction} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="LL.Activity"></x-import>
```

## Props (ActivityProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` * | `string` | "Engaged in Combat", "Idle". |
| `remaining` | `string` | Time left, as printed ("00:12"). |
| `value` | `number` | Progress as value of max. |
| `max` | `number` |  |
| `progress` | `number` | Progress 0–1, when there is no max. |
| `onOpen` | `() => void` | Makes it a button that goes to the action. |
| `openLabel` | `string` | "Go to action" by default; '' for none. |
| `compact` | `boolean` | The compact rail's mark (D-117): a ring the progress rises in, the ✦ and the live dot, over the `short` word. |
| `short` | `string` | Compact: the one word under the mark ("Battling", "Stopping"); the label by default. |
| `className` | `string` |  |
